newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-GRAND NATIONAL WINNER ALDANITI DIES.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-GRAND NATIONAL WINNER ALDANITI DIES.

text.p: Aldaniti, the horse that inspired jockey Bob Champion to fight off cancer and win the Aintree Grand National, has died at the age of 27.
Aldaniti, who recovered from a series of injuries to win the big race in 1981, spent much of his time in retirement making appearances for cancer charities.
Champion, now a trainer, beat off cancer to ride Aldaniti to a tear-jerking success at Liverpool. Their exploits were later the subject of a film.
This year's Grand National is on April 5.
